subject: Air-gapped evidence package, signing timeline and deployment decision gate
messages:
From: Cicero Ops <cicero.ops@acme-corp.com>

Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Air-gapped evidence package and deploy gate criteria

Hi team,

We're gearing up for the offline appliance handoff and need a clear, machine-verifiable evidence package from Redwood for the air-gapped image and the update cadence. Key asks from our side:

- Exact artifact list and formats (signed image, manifest, sbom, attestations).
- Signing scheme details (who signs, signature format, verification steps we should run in our sterile environment).
- Chain-of-custody / courier handoff checklist (what to expect at acceptance).
- A deployment decision gate checklist we can use in our change board (what tests/attestations must pass before we activate the image).

Can you send an initial plan and target dates? We are looking to schedule acceptance the week of June 29 if feasible.

Thanks,
--
Cicero Alvarez
Head of Platform Ops, Acme Corp
cicero.ops@acme-corp.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Cicero Ops <cicero.ops@acme-corp.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Air-gapped evidence package and deploy gate criteria

Cicero — thanks for the clear list. Below is an initial evidence package plan and the deployment decision gate we propose. We can walk through this in a 30-minute call tomorrow.

1) Artifact bundle (delivered on encrypted physical media):
   - signed-image.tar.gz (container image flattened for offline install)
   - image_manifest_v1.json (contains image hash, build id, sbom_ref, build provenance)
   - sbom.yml (CycloneDX, signed)
   - runtime_attestation.sig (detached signature over manifest + sbom)
   - operator_checklist.pdf (deployment steps & smoke tests)

2) Signing scheme and verification steps:
   - We perform build signing in our build HSM (YubiHSM/HSM-backed KMS). Artifacts get an x509 chain; signatures are RFC 5656 detached signatures (we'll provide PKI bundle).
   - We will timestamp the signature via RFC 3161 timestamper and include the timestamp token in the evidence package.
   - Verification steps for your sterile site:
     a) Verify signature against the provided CA bundle (sha256 fingerprint supplied).
     b) Verify timestamp token to ensure signing time matches expected window.
     c) Validate image hash in image_manifest_v1.json against the extracted image (sha256).
     d) Validate SBOM signature and ensure it matches manifest.sbom_ref.

   - We will include an automated verification script (verify_airgap.sh) you can run locally; it will exit non-zero on any mismatch.

3) Chain-of-custody and courier handoff:
   - Physical media will be shipped with tamper-evident seals and a manifest signed by our logistics service.
   - Courier (SecureCourier) will provide a time-stamped pickup/transfer log.
   - On acceptance, your operator will sign the chain-of-custody acceptance form (we include a template).

4) Deployment decision gate (recommended MUSTs):
   - Artifact signature verification succeeds (HSM-signed cert chain validated).
   - Timestamp token within acceptable window (<30 days from build time unless otherwise agreed).
   - SBOM present and verified; no disallowed packages flagged in our agreed blacklist.
   - Smoke tests (operator_checklist) pass: node boots, runtime service reaches ready state, core API responds to health probe.
   - Rollback procedure tested in dry-run (we recommend a staged activation: canary on 1 node, then fleet).

5) Rollback and emergency flow:
   - Image revocation list (IRL) published to a signed revocations.json (we'll provide an offline mechanism for you to consume updates).
   - We will pre-stage a hotfix image and provide signed hotfix bundle in a hold-back repository with its own manifest.

Attachments: [Attachment: image_manifest_v1.json], [Attachment: deployment_checklist_v1.pdf], [Attachment: verify_airgap.sh (stub)]

Proposed timeline:
- June 24: Finalize signing CA fingerprints and courier contact.
- June 26: Redwood generates evidence_package_v1 and transfers to SecureCourier.
- Week of June 29: Onsite acceptance / activation window (your preference of date/time).

If this matches your expectations we'll lock dates and circulate the verification script and CA fingerprints.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
VP, Private Deployments | Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, Cicero Ops <cicero.ops@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 13:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Air-gapped evidence package and deploy gate criteria

Adding a couple of security controls we should make explicit for Acme's acceptance board:

- Signed attestations: each build will include a short, signed attestation stating build inputs (git commit, base image digest), builder identity (CI worker id), and build toolchain fingerprint. Attestations are signed with a separate attestation key to reduce blast radius.
- Reproducibility notes: we will include a reproducible-builds.md with build flags and a pointer to the deterministic build environment for third-party verification where feasible.
- Timestamping and non-repudiation: RFC3161 timestamp tokens included in the evidence package are required for your compliance checks; we'll provide the timestamper CA chain.
- SBOM policy enforcement: verify AirGap SBOM against our agreed whitelist/blacklist and produce a short SBOM-verification log as a deployment artifact.
- Operator tokens: we require operator authentication to happen via locally-generated ephemeral tokens; we will not ship persistent credentials.

Operational ask: can Acme confirm their root CA fingerprint for reuse in their sterile verification environment, and whether they have an internal RFC3161 verifier or would like us to include an offline verifier binary?

Neha
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sbom_policy_matrix.xlsx (stub)]
